topPRs.title: Add EFIX RWA tokens on Base: BRLE, sBRLE, efixDI
topPRs.author: Ernesto711
topPRs.body:
## Adding EFIX RWA tokens on Base

This PR adds three production-deployed tokens from the EFIX protocol (https://efix.finance), all live on Base mainnet (chainId 8453):

| Folder    | Symbol  | Name                       | Base address                                  |
|-----------|---------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| `BRLE`    | BRLE    | Brazilian Real Electronic  | `0x7D12a82E335EB2Be0789A33CE2EBF7Eb2bA782F6`  |
| `sBRLE`   | sBRLE   | Staked BRLE                | `0xC65069694e32ef72CD94649BC5174DF9D18475D0`  |
| `efixDI`  | efixDI  | efixDI Plus                | `0xF5cA55f3ea5Bcd180aEa6dF9E05a0E63A66f5608`  |

### Issuer & legitimacy

EFIX is a CVM-licensed Brazilian securitizer:
- Resolution 88/2022 securitization license
- Ato Declaratório 23.635/2025 (CVM)
- Smart contracts audited by OpenZeppelin (March 2026, 15/15 findings resolved)
- Monthly attestation by Harris & Trotter (chartered accountants)

### What these tokens do

- **BRLE** — Brazilian Real-pegged stablecoin, backed 1:1 by BRL in segregated custody, redeemable on-chain via the EFIX Peg Stability Module.
- **sBRLE** — ERC-4626 yield vault on BRLE, accruing yield from regulated BRL-denominated investments.
- **efixDI+** — Tokenized claim on Brazilian DI (interbank deposit) money-market fund shares, exposing the Brazilian CDI yield curve on-chain. Live as Morpho Blue collateral on Base.

### Verification & live integrations

- Contracts verified on BaseScan:
  - https://basescan.org/address/0x7D12a82E335EB2Be0789A33CE2EBF7Eb2bA782F6
  - https://basescan.org/address/0xC65069694e32ef72CD94649BC5174DF9D18475D0
  - https://basescan.org/address/0xF5cA55f3ea5Bcd180aEa6dF9E05a0E63A66f5608
- Live Morpho Blue market (efixDI / USDC): https://app.morpho.org/base/market/0x31d65cadef8eb085dd3bead61b987b3f86a7ac7d3e1f4763f6d4ec6a477d345a
- DefiLlama: https://defillama.com/protocol/efixdi
- Canonical Uniswap-format tokenlist: https://efix.finance/tokenlist.json

### Notes

- `nobridge: true` is set on all three — EFIX tokens are Base-native and not bridgeable via the standard OP-Stack canonical bridge (mint/burn is gated by the EFIX protocol itself).
- The on-chain symbol of the third token is `efixDI` (no `+`). The "+" suffix is brand-side ("efixDI Plus"); the contract's `symbol()` returns `"efixDI"`.
- Logos are 256×256 PNGs (~7 KB each) using the official EFIX hex mark in white over the per-token color (green / blue / purple).
